messages:
maria: Kicking off the deploy window for release v2.4.0 (model: quantize-v3). Traffic shift scheduled: 0 -> 10% at T+2m, then 30% at T+7m, full at T+20m. Pinning canary to v2.4.0. Watching SLOs and error-budget. Change window ends 2026-03-20 22:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: deploy started — traffic_shift=10% target=v2.4.0 stage=canary user=maria link=https://deploy.redwood.internal/release/2.4.0 status=started :rocket:

ajay: saw p99 latency on embed-service jump from 180ms -> 420ms at T+4m, looks correlated with canary traffic. dashboard: https://console.redwood.internal/dashboards/slo?svc=embed&p=latency

olivia: alert: error-budget-burn for /embed exceeded 6% in last 5m, current burn 8%. PD incident opened: PD-987 (acknowledged). :warning:

sre-oncall: hold the rollout. pause traffic shift and route canary traffic to fallback-model (v2.3.1) while we triage. I can patch routing config now.

ken: command to pin back quickly if needed:
```
# pin service to stable variant
kubectl patch svc embed-service -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"model-pin":"v2.3.1"}}}}}'
```

deploy-bot: traffic_shift halted by sre-oncall at 1998765445. current_traffic_to_v2.4.0=10% -> routing pinned to v2.3.1 for new sessions.

olivia: metrics update: p50/p95 latency trending back toward baseline after routing change, error-rate down from 0.9% -> 0.18% in 3m. continuing to watch for regressions. :white_check_mark:

ajay: capturing a short postmortem note in release doc — likely regression introduced by KV-cache changes in quantize-v3. Will mark rollout as paused and add blocking test.

maria: good catch team. We'll keep the release paused for the remainder of the change window. Release notes draft: https://docs.redwood.internal/releases/2.4.0-draft. Next steps: (1) revert KV-cache change on staging, (2) run targeted perf e2e, (3) re-run canary with 5% pilot for 30m.

sre-oncall: closing PD incident, moving to monitor-only. Leaving routing pinned to v2.3.1. If any new alerts in next 30m ping here.

maria: thanks all — tagging @eng-releases and @product for visibility. :handshake:
